        boolean inside;
        int maxOutside = -1;
        int currentOutside = 0;
        int currentInside = 0;
        int insideWords = 0;

        void processOutside(char c) {

        void processInside(char c) {

                    insideWords++;
                    currentInside = 0;
                }
                if (c == ')') {
                    inside = false;
                }
            }

        void maybeEnterParenthesis(char c) {

                inside = true;
            }
        }

        void finish() {
            if (currentOutside > 0) {
                maxOutside = Math.max(maxOutside, currentOutside);
            }
        }
    }

        String s = sc.next();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
